verdict: Valero earned $6.8B — about six times a year ago — as its refineries ran at near-record rates and refining profit alone hit $8.8B.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: vs $3.53 a year ago; adjusted EPS was $23.90

segments.name: Refining
segments.note: Making gasoline, diesel and jet fuel at 14 refineries — sales to outside customers. Throughput averaged 3.0 million barrels a day at near-record utilization, and the segment earned $8,782M of operating income.

segments.name: Renewable Diesel
segments.note: The Diamond Green Diesel joint venture's low-carbon diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, sold to outside customers. The segment swung to a $353M operating profit from a $28M loss a year ago (most of its sales are to Valero's own Refining segment and are eliminated here).

segments.name: Ethanol
segments.note: Corn ethanol from 12 plants — production hit a record 4.8 million gallons a day and the segment earned $272M.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — headquarters, legal and back office.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization (corporate)
opex.note: Depreciation Valero reports outside cost of sales (most depreciation sits inside cost of sales).

opex.name: Other operating expenses
opex.note: Small other operating items, including $4M of Port Arthur Refinery fire expenses.

otherDetail: Other income of $127M, less $144M of interest and debt expense and $161M of profit belonging to noncontrolling partners (mostly the other member of the Diamond Green Diesel joint venture) — so the flow lands on the $6,828M attributable to Valero stockholders (consolidated net income was $6,989M).
footerNote: Segment revenues are sales to external customers; intersegment sales are eliminated in consolidation. Cost of revenue is Valero's total cost of sales ($36,691M — materials, taxes other than income taxes, operating expenses and depreciation reported inside cost of sales); the operating-expense lines below it are the ones Valero reports outside cost of sales.

takeaways.title: Refining had a monster quarter
takeaways.text: Refining operating income was $8,782M, up from $1,649M a year ago, on near-record throughput of 3.0 million barrels a day — wide refining margins turned straight into profit.

takeaways.title: Renewable diesel swung to profit
takeaways.text: Diamond Green Diesel earned $353M versus a $28M loss a year ago, and Ethanol earned $272M on record production of 4.8 million gallons a day.

takeaways.title: Half the cash went back to shareholders
takeaways.text: Valero generated $6.9B of operating cash flow, spent only $432M on capital investments, and paid out 52% of adjusted operating cash flow to stockholders.
